PC Data Recovery — Portable Package
===================================

Run PCDataRecovery.exe on any modern Windows 10/11 PC.

No installation of Python, XAMPP, PHP, Visual Studio, or CMake is required.

Folders
-------
config\   Application settings
data\     Recovery history and default recovered-files folder
logs\     Diagnostic log (pcdr.log)

Safety
------
* Source drives are opened read-only during scan/recovery.
* Do not recover files back onto the same source drive.
* Stop using a drive that contains deleted data you care about —
  continued writes can overwrite recoverable content.

Administrator rights may be required for low-level volume access.
